base_checkpoint: 46b5703 Acquire feature-profile evidence and record NO-GO

defect.mechanism: measure_slots filtered samples by through/open state before counting, then independently accepted any matching width and any matching depth. A group could therefore pass when different samples supplied the matching dimensions, and blind samples could be removed before count verification.

false_positive_reproduction.old_result: satisfied=true because width and depth each had one matching value
false_positive_reproduction.correct_result: satisfied=false because the second selected sample fails both dimensions

current_behavior_reconstruction.sample_filtering: Only dictionary samples were retained; through/open=false samples and samples outside required_region were removed before count and dimension checks.
current_behavior_reconstruction.region_filtering: When required_region was supplied, exact string equality selected the region. Nonmatching regions were intentionally excluded by the caller's region selector.
current_behavior_reconstruction.through_state: The old implementation required truthy through or open, but because it filtered first, a mixed through/blind input could hide the blind sample and pass a smaller expected count.
current_behavior_reconstruction.count: Count was the number of post-through, post-region samples, with exact equality to expected_count. expected_count=0 and an empty group could pass when dimensions were unspecified.
current_behavior_reconstruction.width: When expected_width was supplied, any numeric width within tolerance was sufficient.
current_behavior_reconstruction.depth_length: The function's canonical input is expected_depth/depth. It did not have an independent length field; callers that use a planar length must map that meaning before this function.
current_behavior_reconstruction.tolerance: Absolute tolerance was used, but decimal boundary values could fail due to binary floating-point representation.
current_behavior_reconstruction.missing_fields: Missing or nonnumeric dimensions were omitted from aggregate lists, so one remaining matching sample could satisfy a group with missing dimensions.
current_behavior_reconstruction.mixed_groups: Width and depth were aggregated independently, allowing width from one sample and depth from another to form a false PASS.

callers.candidate_group: target.slot_samples or feature.slot_samples supplied by the feature/validation contract
callers.region: required_region is passed from target.region when present; this is the legitimate sample-group selector
callers.output_identity: The evaluation is already scoped to the requested output_id and mesh; measure_slots intentionally does not infer or assign output identity.
callers.count_semantics: expected_count is exact for the selected sample group
callers.dimension_semantics: target.width and target.depth are passed as expected_width and expected_depth; every selected sample must satisfy each supplied constraint after the fix
callers.through_semantics: measure_slots historically and currently requires through/open for every selected sample
callers.extra_samples: Samples outside an explicit required_region are excluded by that selector; extra samples within the selected group cause count failure or sample-constraint failure.
callers.legacy_permissiveness_dependency: No second production caller was found. Existing tests encoded the permissive behavior and were corrected to the generic contract.

corrected_generic_contract.selector: Select the legitimate group from scope/region information only. Dimensions must never select the subset being verified.
corrected_generic_contract.empty_group: FAIL closed, including expected_count=0, because no qualifying group was observed.
corrected_generic_contract.count: The selected group must contain exactly expected_count samples; too few and too many fail.
corrected_generic_contract.through: Every selected sample must be through/open when the measure_slots contract is used; mixed through/blind groups fail.
corrected_generic_contract.dimensions: For each supplied expected dimension, every selected sample must have a numeric value within the declared absolute tolerance. Missing values fail closed.
corrected_generic_contract.tolerance_boundary: The declared tolerance remains authoritative; a small comparison epsilon handles decimal floating-point representation without changing the reported tolerance.
corrected_generic_contract.wrong_region: Nonmatching regions are excluded only when required_region explicitly selects another region; they cannot contaminate that selected group.
corrected_generic_contract.diagnostics: Retain aggregate measurements and add expected dimensions, failed sample indices, per-sample observed values/states, failed constraints, and top-level failure reasons.

synthetic_test_matrix.case: one sample has both dimensions wrong
count matches but dimensions are mixed
dimensions match but count does not
wrong-region samples do not contaminate legitimate group
mixed through/blind when through is required

implementation.decision: Fix at the shared measure_slots boundary; do not add feature-profile schema or caller-specific aggregation modes.
implementation.behavior: Build the selected group before access/dimension verification, verify exact nonempty count, require all selected samples to satisfy through/open and every requested dimension, and preserve per-sample diagnostics.
implementation.output_identity: Unchanged; remains an upstream scope responsibility.

before_after.synthetic_red: The new 14-case suite produced 9 expected failures against the old behavior, including the mixed-dimension false PASS, mixed through/blind false PASS, missing-dimension false PASS, empty-group PASS, missing diagnostics, outside-tolerance false PASS, and decimal-boundary false failure.
before_after.synthetic_green: 14/14 new aggregation tests passed after the fix.
before_after.focused_regression: 36/36 passed across slot aggregation, feature measurements, feature-profile characterization, and feature evidence tests.
historical_test_updates: The existing slot test now uses two matching samples and explicitly asserts a mixed through/blind group fails.
The prior characterization test now asserts the mixed-dimension group fails and identifies sample index 1; it no longer encodes permissive behavior.

frozen_development_impact.claim: No development-corpus outcome change is claimed.

ownership_confirmation.upstream_scope_owner: feature_evidence remains responsible for output/feature scope; no scope defect was introduced or repaired here.

anti_overfitting.generic_rule: The same group-level all-sample contract applies to any caller-supplied slot/sample group.

tests.red_result: 9 failures in the new 14-case suite before production implementation; failures matched the known permissive aggregation and boundary behavior
